english: Ho is described as "absorbed in all created things" in the sense that he is the very soul of things, having his mind intent upon the idea that "all things are to be created by me;" when for instance, the jar made of clay, having its body built out of clay, is said to be "absorbed in consisting of the clay;" similarly when a certain person ponders too much over a thing, he is described figuratively, as "absorbed" in that thing; as we find in such expressions as "this person is absorbed in women," "he is absorbed in the Ṛgveda," "he is absorbed in the Yajurveda," and so forth.
